overloads.semanticRole: The Selection to JSON command returns a string containing a JSON array with as many elements as there are records in the current selection of aTable .

constraints: aField and template are alternative ways to restrict which fields are serialized; pass at most one of them. If neither is passed, all JSON-expressible fields of aTable are included (BLOB and Picture fields are always ignored).
After the call, the current selection is unchanged but the current record is no longer loaded and may have changed.
